Welcome to my new website! After running a Hugo site for several years, I've rebuilt everything using [Quarto](https://quarto.org).

Quarto offers several key features for an academic site:

- **Markdown** for easy content authoring
- **BibTeX citations** --- just write `[@Dax:2021myb]` to cite a paper from a `.bib` file
- **LaTeX math** --- inline ($x=y$) and display equations work natively:
$$p(\theta|d) = \frac{p(d|\theta)p(\theta)}{p(d)}$$
- **Code execution** via Jupyter notebooks and other engines
- **Dark/light mode** toggle built in

The source code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/{{< var github >}}).
